description: Returns the institution's calendars (one entry per doctor + workstation/location combination). Use calendarid from here as input to get_work_days.php.

Calendars.name: string - display name of the calendar (usually same as doctor_name)
Calendars.interventiontypes: array - intervention type options, maps to post_schedule.php's interventionType index
Calendars.problem_description: string - newline-separated list of problem/reason options for this calendar
Calendars.calendarid: string - opaque encrypted id, required input to get_work_days.php

sample_entry.name: Dr. Baricz Anna
sample_entry.problem_description:
Prescriere ochelari
Prescriere lentile de contact
Tensiune oculara
Fund de ochi

example_response_live_2026-08-31.note: Optofarm is an optometry/ophthalmology clinic network across Tg. Mures, Reghin, Sovata; 30 calendar entries = distinct doctor+location pairs. Full list saved separately, not in this doc file, since calendarid values are long opaque tokens best fetched live rather than hardcoded.
